name: smwgraphics-the-smurfs-snes-lake
title: The Smurfs (SNES) - Lake
description:
The background used on The Lake level on The Smurfs (SNES) It uses 269 (0x10D) map16 tiles and 26 colors.

(I had to remain a empty space below the bg due to the converted size of the bg, but with the correct BG position setup it shouldn't be a problem)

Uses the second half of palette 6 and 7.
